theorem: The binary GQ Levi homology has neither a PSp-fixed vector nor a trivial quotient. Hence the four-dimensional characteristic-two trivial socle of flag H1 cannot transfer equivariantly into Levi H1, and Levi H1 cannot map equivariantly onto a trivial line.
boundary: Exact linear PSp-module obstruction; nonlinear correspondences or maps through larger induced modules are not excluded.
